ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions and 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones across the central area of both lobes; low-intensity black perimeter banding; high-density clusters of black mottling localized around the median notch and the lower-trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes, characterized by peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 18 pixels, creating a jagged non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep trajectory originating from the distal tips and converging toward the median notch; leading edges show slight convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of brown-toned, circular, high-relief pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; dark circular mottling clusters on the lower medial quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of two distinct dark, parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions on the upper right lobe and several vertical dark linear marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent colonization by acorn barnacles on the outer distal edges; distinct linear scarring/rake marks on the right lobe surface; highly irregular serrated profile on trailing edges indicating historical tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast black 'island' pigmentation pattern located at the vertex of the median notch.
